description: I am an ICT student interested in programming, mobile development, and space technology. I know Java, Dart, Flutter, SQL, and Git/GitHub. I want to join NASA Space Apps Challenge to learn, solve real-world problems, and build innovative solutions. I am looking for teammates interested in programming, science, data analysis, and design. I value teamwork, creativity, and collaboration.
summary: LunaPath is an interactive lunar exploration platform designed to support the exploration of the Moon, with a special focus on the Lunar South Pole. It provides an immersive 3D Moon visualization where users can explore lunar locations, discover potential landing sites, and learn about historical crewed and robotic missions. The platform also includes a Mission Planner that helps users investigate sunlight availability, Earth visibility, and other mission-related conditions based on selected dates and times. Additionally, users can compare different lunar locations to better understand their characteristics. LunaPath combines modern web technologies, scientific computing, and NASA-related data sources to transform complex lunar information into an accessible and engaging experience. Its goal is to make lunar exploration easier to understand and support informed decisions for future lunar missions.
